title: Cosmic Tentacle Eclipse
description: A surreal monochrome painting depicts a massive, ornate tentacled creature with spiral patterns and an eye, coiling around a swirling black vortex in a barren mountainous landscape. In the stormy sky above, a total solar eclipse is visible behind dark clouds.
prompt: Surrealist oil painting of a giant ornate spiral tentacle creature with detailed patterns and a single eye, wrapping around a swirling black vortex portal, set in a desolate rocky mountain range under a dark stormy sky with a total solar eclipse, dramatic lighting, monochromatic sepia and black color palette, ominous atmosphere
